_comment: Accepted exceptions for the dependency-audit check (.github/workflows/dependency-audit.yml; SECURITY_BASELINE.md section 6). An entry lets one advisory pass in one lockfile until its review date; after that date the check fails. Each entry needs the owner's written acceptance (acceptedBy), recorded on the pull request that adds or renews it, in the form: owner's name, date, link to the acceptance comment. The check enforces that the review date is at most 30 days (high) or 7 days (critical) after firstReported (baseline section 4).
